parameters.name: raster
parameters.description:
Controls which image variant is returned.

- `true` — Returns a **raster (bitmap) rendering** of the floor map **always as PNG** (`Content-Type: image/png`), regardless of the original upload format. 
- `false` — Returns the **original uploaded file** in its native format. Check the `Content-Type` header, which will be one of: `image/png`, `image/jpeg`, or `image/svg+xml`.

get.description:
Retrieves the background image associated with a specific floor within a site.

The image is returned as a **binary stream**. Callers must inspect the `Content-Type` response header to determine the exact image format before processing or displaying the image.

### Supported Output Formats

- **`image/png` (Binary)** — Always returned when `raster=true`; also returned when the original upload was a PNG file
- **`image/jpeg` (Binary)** — Returned when `raster=false` and the original upload was a JPEG file  
- **`image/svg+xml` (UTF-8 XML)** — Returned when `raster=false` and the original upload was an SVG file

200.description: Floor map image has been fetched for a given floor.

schema.description: UTF-8 encoded SVG XML text document representing the floor map. SVG preserves full vector fidelity and can be scaled without quality loss.

image/svg+xml.example: <?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="800" height="600" viewBox="0 0 800 600"><rect x="0" y="0" width="800" height="600" fill="#f0f0f0"/><path d="M 100 100 L 700 100 L 700 500 L 100 500 Z" stroke="black" fill="none"/></svg>

get.summary: Retrieves placed devices over the FloorMap
get.description: A list of placed devices on the FloorMap is returned. Currently, geoMetry is not supported; only x and y are returned in meters in geometryRelative.

200.description: Returns a list of placed devices on the FloorMap.

This API is utilized to position the devices on a **FloorMap** for a specific floor ID.
The devices are required to be assigned to the floor before being placed. GeometryRelative should be in meters in this version.

geometryRelative.description: A list of x and y in the same order.
